orgs.name: StepFun
orgs.description: Shanghai AI company that releases open speech-to-speech and audio models (Step-Audio, Step-Audio 2, StepAudio 3) alongside its Step language models and the open Step-Video-T2V video model.
orgs.description_zh: 上海的人工智能公司，除 Step 系列语言模型和开源视频模型 Step-Video-T2V 外，还发布开源的语音到语音与音频模型（Step-Audio、Step-Audio 2、StepAudio 3）。

orgs.name: Zhipu AI (Z.ai)
orgs.description: Beijing AI company spun out of Tsinghua University, maker of the GLM models; its open video work runs from CogVideoX (2024) to the SCAIL character-animation models (2025–2026), and it released the open GLM-4-Voice spoken chatbot.
orgs.description_zh: 源自清华大学的北京人工智能公司，GLM 系列模型的开发者；其开源视频工作从 CogVideoX（2024）延续到 SCAIL 角色动画模型（2025–2026），还发布了开源语音对话模型 GLM-4-Voice。

orgs.name: Moonshot AI
orgs.description: Beijing AI company behind the Kimi assistant and the open Kimi K-series models; its open Kimi-Audio (2025) handles speech understanding, generation and spoken conversation in one model.
orgs.description_zh: 开发 Kimi 助手和开源 Kimi K 系列模型的北京人工智能公司；其开源的 Kimi-Audio（2025）在一个模型中完成语音理解、生成和语音对话。

orgs.name: Xiaomi MiMo
orgs.description: Xiaomi's foundation-model team, which publishes open language, vision and audio models; MiMo-Audio (2025) showed few-shot speech continuation and voice conversion from large-scale audio pretraining, followed by MiMo-V2 and V2.5 TTS models for agents.
orgs.description_zh: 小米的基础大模型团队，发布开源的语言、视觉与音频模型；MiMo-Audio（2025）展示了大规模音频预训练带来的少样本语音续写和声音转换能力，之后又推出面向智能体的 MiMo-V2 与 V2.5 TTS 模型。

orgs.name: PixVerse (AISphere)
orgs.description: Beijing start-up whose PixVerse app and API generate short videos with sound (V5 to V6, 2025–2026) and which also builds real-time world models (R1, R2).
orgs.description_zh: 北京创业公司，其 PixVerse 应用和 API 可生成带声音的短视频（V5 至 V6，2025–2026），并研发实时世界模型（R1、R2）。
known_for: PixVerse R1 / R2 real-time world models (2026)
